package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestMigration029AddsStudentCancellationWithoutRejectingHistoricalRows(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/029_practice_learning_action_student_cancel.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sql := string(payload)
	for _, expected := range []string{
		"cancel_reason = 'practice_provisioning_failed' AND opened_at IS NULL",
		"cancel_reason = 'student_cancelled' AND (opened_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= opened_at)",
		"evidence_class IS NULL AND outcome IS NULL AND outcome_policy_version IS NULL",
		") NOT VALID;",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(sql, expected) {
			t.Errorf("migration 029 is missing %q", expected)
		}
	}
}
